source: Nonaka × AI Knowledge Creation project — research/expansion-research.md
description: Presets for the Knowledge Spiral Lab simulator. Each preset defines the starting conditions of an organization's knowledge spiral.

presets.name: NotCo / Giuseppe
presets.description: AI proposes formulations, chefs taste and judge, feedback returns to the model. Tacit machine knowledge becomes portable and sellable.

presets.name: Matsushita Home Bakery
presets.description: Apprenticeship leads to articulation: 'twist and stretch' becomes a product spec. The classic SECI spiral, mostly human.

presets.name: Siloed Org
presets.description: Knowledge trapped in individuals and teams. Low redundancy, low chaos, no feedback loop. The spiral crawls: most conversion attempts fail, and combined knowledge loses its shared context.

presets.name: AI-Native Org
presets.description: Agents do combination and internalization at machine scale. Shared context layer (digital Ba) makes machine transfer the dominant movement.

presets.name: Green Milk
presets.description: Machine knowledge without shared context. Giuseppe proposes dill; the milk is green. Watch the spiral stall on false externalization.

presets.name: Khanmigo Classroom
presets.description: A tutor that guides, not answers. Explicit knowledge becomes tacit skill through measured practice. Internalization is the star.
